Rep.  BY THE PP, ASSAM Advocate for the Petitioner : MR N BARMAN Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM  BEFORE  THE HON'BLE MR JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY  ORDER 18.10.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

This is an application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. praying for granting regular bail to the petitioner, Sri Mun Ch. Deka, who was arrested on Page No.# 2/3 14.09.2023 in connection with Nalbari PS case No. 398/2023 under Section 420/493/376/323 IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Investigation is almost over and the accused has thoroughly been interrogated by the investigating agency.
There is no legal evidence against the present applicants to connect him with the alleged offence.

The learned Counsel further submits that the applicant is in Mun Ch Deka vs The State Of Assam on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138504337/
1 custody since 14.09.2023 and the conclusion of trial will take sufficient time.

sentences.text: On the aforesaid grounds, prayer is made to release the applicant on bail.
Considering the period of detention and nature of allegations, this Court is of the opinion that no further custodial detention of the petitioner is required.
Accordingly, the present application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Nalbari with the following conditions.

(1) The petitioner shall not hamper with the investigation, or tamper with the evidence of the case, (2) The petitioner shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer,
(3) The petitioner shall appear before the I/O on each and every date as and when called for.
Page No.# 3/3 Bail application stands disposed of.
